about: Every number and claim this lesson shows or says, with its source. ServiceTitan's article 'After the job: Get paid, manage your reputation' (Mike Persinger, May 6, 2026) re-read Nov 8, 2026 (Central) with WebFetch in the live chat; the quoted lines were on it that day. The 94% is Visa's figure as ServiceTitan reports it. The job, the check, three weeks, the driveway line and the card reader are ours (EXAMPLE on screen). We never attach a year or study name to the 94%. We never say how many homeowners don't pay, how long checks take, or that paying on site gets paid faster: no source here gives those for home service.

visa.title: After the job: Get paid, manage your reputation
visa.author: Mike Persinger
visa.population: home service customers (Visa figures; no year given on the page for the 94%)
confirms: Visa figures show that 94% of home service customers own a credit card, and 90% of those cardholders use theirs regularly.
In 2015-16, Visa data shows, 59% of home service spending was paid by check.

example.what: ours: a job finished, the homeowner promises a check, none comes; the driveway line and the card reader are ours, labeled EXAMPLE
